title: Sava Keruya

paragraphs: In Shabbat 45b, a certain old man of Kruya—and some say Sruya—asked Rabbi Yohanan. Rashi explains Sruya/Kruya as designations after their places.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Here ע״ש means “named after,” because it is followed by “their places.” Kruya and Sruya are the source’s two forms.
The consulted Rashi on Shabbat 45b describes the two forms as designations after his place; neither place is identified here.
